[[Madison Square Garden]] | champion = [[Legends Classic (basketball tournament)|Legends Classic]] champions | tourney = [[2019 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] | tourney_result = First Four }} {{2018–19 Big East men's basketball standings}} The '''2018–19 St. John's Red Storm men's basketball team''' represented [[St. John's University (New York City)|St. John's University]] during the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. They were coached by [[alumnus]] and [[Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame]] member [[Chris Mullin (basketball)|Chris Mullin]], in his fourth year at the school. They played their home games at [[Carnesecca Arena]] and [[Madison Square Garden]] as members of the [[Big East Conference]]. They finished the season 21–13, 8–10 in [[2018–19 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East Play]] to finish in seventh place. They defeated [[2018–19 DePaul Blue Demons men's basketball team|DePaul]] in the first round of the [[2019 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]] before losing [[2018–19 Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball team|Marquette]] in the quarter-finals. They received an at-large bid to the [[2019 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as an 11th seed. However, they lost to fellow 11th seed [[2018–19 Arizona State Sun Devils men's basketball team|Arizona State]] at the First Four. On April 9, 2019, head coach Chris Mullin resigned after four seasons.{{Cite web|url=https://www.si.com/college-basketball/2019/04/09/chris-mullin-st-johns-coach-steps-down|title=Chris Mullin steps down as St. John's coach|website=SI.com|language=en|access-date=2019-07-11}} On April 19, the school announced it had hired former [[Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball|Arkansas]] head coach [[Mike Anderson (basketball, born 1959)|Mike Anderson]] as the team's new coach.{{Cite news|url=https://www.nytimes.com/2019/04/19/sports/st-johns-mike-anderson.html|title=St. John’s Hires Mike Anderson as New Men’s Basketball Coach|agency=Associated Press|date=2019-04-19|work=The New York Times|access-date=2019-07-11|language=en-US|issn=0362-4331}} ==Previous season== The [[2017–18 St. John's Red Storm men's basketball team|Red Storm]] finished the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2017–18 season]] with a record of 16–17, 4–14 in [[2017–18 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to finish in ninth place in the conference. They defeated [[2017–18 Georgetown Hoyas men's basketball team|Georgetown]] in the first round of the [[2018 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]] before losing to [[2017–18 Xavier Musketeers men's basketball team|Xavier]] in the quarterfinals.{{Cite news|url=https://www.cincinnati.com/story/sports/college/xavier/2018/03/08/live-updates-xavier-basketball-plays-st-johns-open-big-east-tournament/407218002/|title=Top-seeded Xavier basketball trounces St. John's in Big East tournament|work=Cincinnati.com|access-date=2018-04-23|language=en}}{{Cite news|url=https://www.newsday.com/sports/college/college-basketball/big-east-tournament-xavier-stays-alive-with-upset-over-butler-r05482|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180424072149/https://www.newsday.com/sports/college/st-johns/big-east-tournament-xavier-st-johns-1.17210764|url-status=live|archive-date=April 24, 2018|title=St. John’s falls to Xavier in Big East quarters|work=Newsday|access-date=2018-04-23|language=en}} ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
